notes: Connecting a display by QR code: the phone now shows whose family it holds (with everyone’s names) before you can press Yes – so helping a relative with the same surname can’t put your family on their screen by mistake.
Setup: after “Carry on with setup”, the new tab keeps trying to connect for up to two minutes, and an old setup tab notices by itself (it checks every few seconds).

Setup: waiting at “Make your Sheet” with a Sheet that didn’t answer, it quietly tries again every 10 seconds. A setup tab left open from an older release reloads itself with the newest one when you come back to it.
